context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: User Account Management Test Suite.

checklist.name: Given/When/Then structure
checklist.description: All scenarios follow proper Gherkin Given/When/Then structure with clear steps

checklist.name: Scenario independence
checklist.description: Each scenario creates or mocks its own prerequisites rather than depending on other scenarios

checklist.name: No cross-scenario coupling
checklist.description: Scenarios do NOT assume data or state created by other scenarios

checklist.name: Deterministic execution
checklist.description: Scenarios are designed to produce consistent results regardless of execution order

checklist.name: Self-contained setup
checklist.description: Each scenario includes its own Given steps for required context and data

checklist.name: Single behavior focus
checklist.description: Each scenario focuses on testing one specific behavior or user journey

checklist.name: Cleanup consideration
checklist.description: Scenarios are designed to not leave state that affects other scenarios

checklist.name: Avoids: Any scenario does not follow Given/When/Then structure
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Any scenario does not follow Given/When/Then structure

checklist.name: Avoids: Scenario outcomes vary depending on which other...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Scenario outcomes vary depending on which other scenarios ran before it

checklist.name: Avoids: A scenario lacks Given steps and assumes...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: A scenario lacks Given steps and assumes pre-existing context
